$comment: English UI strings. Must have exactly the same keys as pt-BR.json (generator fails otherwise). DRAFT: humanizer pass pending.

strings.bipe_banner_unverified_body: Account created %1$s ago. Not in your contacts.
strings.bipe_banner_external: Account from outside Bipe. We can't verify this person.
strings.bipe_banner_security_change: This account signed in on a new device and isn't verified there yet.
strings.bipe_warning_money_request_body: Before you pay, check with the person another way. Scammers rush you.
strings.bipe_warning_reserved_name: This name is reserved for verified organisations.
strings.bipe_device_approval_never_for_others: Bipe never asks you to approve someone else's phone.
strings.bipe_badge_suspended_body: This account signed in on a new device. The seal comes back when the person verifies again on that device.
strings.bipe_warning_nickname_confirm_body: You saved this contact as %1$s. The account is verified as %2$s. Is it the same person?
strings.bipe_pix_card_bank_name: Your bank will show the name %1$s. If you see another name, don't pay.
strings.bipe_pix_card_copied: Code copied. Paste it in your bank app.
strings.bipe_pix_card_status_sent: You marked it as sent. It shows as paid when %1$s confirms they got it.
strings.bipe_warning_name_lookalike_emoji: This emoji can't go next to the name. It looks like a verification badge.
strings.bipe_scam_victim_body: Call your bank now and ask for a refund through MED. The sooner, the better your chance of getting the money back.
strings.bipe_settings_language_footer: Choose Portuguese or English in iPhone Settings.
strings.bipe_settings_share_presence_footer: If you turn this off, nobody sees you typing and you don't see others typing. Read receipts always stay on.
strings.bipe_about_steward: Bipe is an experiment by Envisioning, which looks after it but does not want to own it. The servers are in Brazil.
strings.bipe_signup_handle_footer: This is how people find you. You can pick one later.
strings.bipe_handle_too_short: Too short. Use at least %1$s characters.
strings.bipe_handle_too_long: Too long. Use at most %1$s characters.
strings.bipe_handle_invalid_characters: Use only lowercase letters, numbers, dots and underscores. Start with a letter or number and do not end with a dot.
strings.bipe_handle_cooldown_until: You can change it again on %1$s.
strings.bipe_handle_screen_footer: This is how people find you on Bipe. After a change, you wait 30 days to change it again.
strings.bipe_handle_remove_body: Nobody can find you by @%1$s anymore, and your chats show that you no longer use it.
strings.bipe_messaging_everyone_body: People you don't know land in Requests.
strings.bipe_messaging_verified_body: Plus people you already know. Nobody is verified yet, so for now this works like Contacts only.
strings.bipe_messaging_contacts_body: People in a group or chat with you, people you invited and whoever invited you.
strings.bipe_error_invite_invalid: This invite is not valid or was already used.
strings.bipe_error_email_taken: This email is already on another Bipe account. Use a different email.
strings.bipe_error_password_weak: This password is too weak. Pick a longer or less obvious one.
strings.bipe_error_handle_cooldown: You changed your username recently. Try again later.
strings.bipe_error_rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a bit and try again.
strings.bipe_error_unauthorized: Your account left this device. Get back into your account to continue.
strings.bipe_error_network: Cannot reach Bipe. Check your connection and try again.
strings.bipe_error_attestation_invalid: We couldn't confirm this is the official Bipe app. Update the app and try again.
strings.bipe_error_attestation_failed: We couldn't check this phone with Apple. Check your connection and try again.
strings.bipe_signup_display_name_footer: This is the name people see in chats. You can change it later.
strings.bipe_start_chat_handle_not_found: Nobody on Bipe uses @%1$s. Check the spelling.
strings.bipe_profile_qr_footer: Anyone who scans this code opens your Bipe profile.
strings.bipe_link_handle_not_found: We could not find anyone with @%1$s.
strings.bipe_requests_row_body: People who want to chat with you
strings.bipe_request_unverified_body: There is no way yet to know who is behind this account. Only accept if you know this person.
strings.bipe_scam_warning_title: This looks like a common scam
strings.bipe_scam_warning_pix_key: The message has something that looks like a Pix key. Before you pay, check with the person another way, like a phone call.
strings.bipe_scam_warning_delivery_fee: Scammers often ask for a fee by link to release a delivery. Do not pay through the link. Check the tracking in the store's app or on the Correios site.
strings.bipe_scam_warning_lookalike_link: This link's address copies a bank, a government office or a well-known company, but it is not the real one. Do not open the link. Use the app or the site you already use.
strings.bipe_scam_warning_bank_alert: Banks do not send links to unblock an account, a card or Pix. Do not open the link. Open your bank's app and check there.
strings.bipe_scam_warning_pix_code: The message has a Pix copy-and-paste code. Before you pay, check with the person another way and look at the name your bank shows.
strings.bipe_scam_warning_boleto: The message has a boleto code. Fake boletos are a common scam. Before you pay, check in your bank app who gets the money.
strings.bipe_scam_warning_receipt: The message mentions a payment receipt. A screenshot of a receipt does not prove payment. Check in your bank app that the money arrived.
strings.bipe_scam_warning_new_number: Scammers often pretend to be family and say they have a new number or account. Call the number you already have for the person and check that it is them.
strings.bipe_scam_warning_urgency: Rush and money requests show up a lot in scams. Before you do anything, check with the person another way.
strings.bipe_scam_warning_extortion: The message makes a threat and asks for money. Paying does not usually end the threat. Do not pay, and keep the messages. SaferNet helps for free, without asking your name: new.safernet.org.br/helpline
strings.bipe_scam_warning_remote_app: The message asks you to install an app. With an app like this, someone else can use your phone from far away, and banks do not ask for that. Do not install it. Call your bank on the number on your card.
strings.bipe_scam_warning_pin_request: The message asks for a PIN or a code. Nobody from Bipe asks for your PIN, not by message and not by phone call. Do not give it to anyone.
strings.bipe_signup_invite_required: Bipe is opening a few people at a time. To create an account, you need an invite code from someone who already uses it.
strings.bipe_invite_already_signed_in: You already have an account. Invites are for people not on Bipe yet.
strings.bipe_invites_explainer: Each invite works for one person and lasts 30 days. Invite people you know.
strings.bipe_invites_none_left: You have used all your invites.
strings.bipe_invites_empty: You have not invited anyone yet.
strings.bipe_invites_qr_footer: The other person points their phone camera at the code. After installing Bipe, they scan it again and the app opens with the invite filled in.
strings.bipe_trust_footer: Only you can see this profile.
strings.bipe_public_profile_footer: Anyone who opens your link sees the name, photo and bio you put here. Nobody can find your profile by search. You can turn it off any time.
strings.bipe_public_profile_needs_handle: Choose a username first. Your profile link uses your @.
strings.bipe_public_profile_name_too_long: Name too long. Use at most %1$s characters.
strings.bipe_public_profile_bio_too_long: Bio too long. Use at most %1$s characters.
strings.bipe_public_profile_bio_too_many_lines: Use at most %1$s lines in the bio.
strings.bipe_public_profile_photo_invalid: That photo didn't work. Try another one.
strings.bipe_trust_step_email_body: Open a link we send to your email.
strings.bipe_trust_step_pix_body: A R$ 0.01 Pix from your bank account verifies your name.
strings.bipe_trust_step_govbr_body: A signature with your gov.br account verifies your name.
strings.bipe_voice_transcript_placeholder: Check the text before you send
strings.bipe_voice_transcript_unavailable: No transcript. The audio goes without text.
strings.bipe_stickers_empty_body: Your sticker packs show up here.
strings.bipe_stickers_error_load: The stickers did not load. Try again.
strings.bipe_stickers_import_help: In WhatsApp, send the stickers to a group with only you in it. Then use Export chat, choose Attach media and save the file. Here, choose that file.
strings.bipe_stickers_import_help_folder_android: You can also choose the files in the WhatsApp Stickers folder.
strings.bipe_stickers_import_note: Imported stickers are stored on the Bipe server without end-to-end encryption. Import only stickers you may share.
strings.bipe_stickers_import_none: No new stickers in that file.
strings.bipe_stickers_import_failed: The import did not work. Try again.
strings.bipe_sticker_save_failed: The sticker was not saved. Try again.
strings.bipe_contacts_intro: See which of your contacts are already on Bipe. The server only compares the numbers and stores none of them.
strings.bipe_contacts_denied: Bipe has no access to your contacts. You can allow it in iPhone Settings.
strings.bipe_contacts_none: None of your contacts are on Bipe yet.
strings.bipe_contacts_invite: Invite people who are not here
strings.bipe_discovery_toggle: People who have my number can find me
strings.bipe_discovery_footer: Your number is never shown to anyone. Only people who already have you in their contacts can find you.
strings.bipe_phone_not_linked: Your number is not linked yet, so nobody can find you by it for now.
strings.bipe_self_chat_error: Couldn't open your notes. Try again.
strings.bipe_onboarding_point_scam: A warning when a message looks like a scam.
strings.bipe_onboarding_point_brazil: Data and servers stay in Brazil, under Brazilian law.
strings.bipe_onboarding_point_no_ads: No ads. Your data isn't for sale.
strings.bipe_signup_device_header: To create an account, you only need your name. The @ and the email are optional.
strings.bipe_signup_email_optional_footer: Only used to get back into your account if you lose your phone. Nobody else sees it.
strings.bipe_signup_device_success: Account created. It stays on this phone.
strings.bipe_pin_create_body: Pick a PIN with %1$s digits, like your bank PIN. It locks the app and protects getting back into your account.
strings.bipe_pin_never_asked: Nobody from Bipe asks for your PIN. Not by message, not by phone call.
strings.bipe_pin_mismatch: The two PINs do not match. Try again.
strings.bipe_pin_problem_repeated_digit: Repeated digits are easy to guess. Pick another PIN.
strings.bipe_pin_problem_sequence: Sequences are easy to guess. Pick another PIN.
strings.bipe_pin_problem_date: This looks like a date, and dates are easy to guess. Pick another PIN.
strings.bipe_pin_blocked_body: The PIN locked after %1$s wrong tries. Create a new one by email, through your guardians or with your verified CPF.
strings.bipe_pin_change_biometric_reason: Confirm it is you to change the PIN.
strings.bipe_fallback_body: Choose at least one way back into your account. Without one, losing your phone can mean losing the account.
strings.bipe_fallback_email_body: We send you a link. With the link and your PIN, the account comes back after %1$s hours.
strings.bipe_fallback_guardians_body: People you confirmed in person approve getting back into your account. Then there is a %1$s-hour wait.
strings.bipe_fallback_recovery_key_body: The key also brings back your old messages. Nobody at Bipe will ask for it.
strings.bipe_fallback_reminder: You have no way back into your account yet if you lose your phone.
strings.bipe_email_footer: Only used to get back into your account or create a new PIN. Nobody else sees it.
strings.bipe_email_sent: We sent a link to %1$s. Open it to confirm.
strings.bipe_email_link_invalid: This link no longer works. Ask for a new one in the app.
strings.bipe_error_email_unavailable: We cannot send email right now. Try again later.
strings.bipe_recovery_qr_body: Open Bipe on the old phone and point this phone's camera at the QR code that shows there.
strings.bipe_recovery_qr_never_from_others: Bipe never asks you to scan a QR code that someone else sent.
strings.bipe_recovery_token_found: Your account came with this phone's backup. Enter your PIN to sign in.
strings.bipe_recovery_email_body: We send a link to your recovery email. After the link and your PIN, there is a %1$s-hour wait.
strings.bipe_recovery_email_sent: If this email belongs to a Bipe account, the link arrives in a few minutes. Open it on this phone.
strings.bipe_recovery_guardians_body: One guardian approves on their phone. If you have two or more, two must approve. Then your PIN and a %1$s-hour wait.
strings.bipe_recovery_cpf_body: Verify your CPF again. Then your PIN and a %1$s-hour wait.
strings.bipe_recovery_waiting_body: Your account comes back to this phone on %1$s. Your other devices got a notice and can cancel.
strings.bipe_recovery_waiting_pin_body: Your new PIN takes effect on %1$s. Your other devices got a notice and can cancel.
strings.bipe_recovery_ready: Done. Your account is on this phone.
strings.bipe_recovery_pin_ready: Done. Your new PIN works now.
strings.bipe_recovery_history_note: To see your old messages, approve this phone on an old device or use your recovery key.
strings.bipe_recovery_cancelled: Getting back into the account was cancelled on one of your devices.
strings.bipe_error_recovery_invalid: You can't continue from here anymore. Start again.
strings.bipe_recovery_alert_title: Your account is moving to a new device
strings.bipe_recovery_alert_email: Someone used your recovery email to move your account to another device. If it was not you, cancel now. If nobody cancels, the account opens on that device on %1$s.
strings.bipe_recovery_alert_guardian: Your guardians approved moving your account to another device. If it was not you, cancel now. If nobody cancels, the account opens on that device on %1$s.
strings.bipe_recovery_alert_cpf: Someone verified your CPF to move your account to another device. If it was not you, cancel now. If nobody cancels, the account opens on that device on %1$s.
strings.bipe_recovery_alert_pin_reset: Someone asked for a new PIN for your account. If it was not you, cancel now. If nobody cancels, the new PIN takes effect on %1$s.
strings.bipe_recovery_alert_token: Your account signed in on a new device with the iCloud or Google backup and your PIN. If it was not you, change your PIN and sign out of the devices you do not know.
strings.bipe_recovery_alert_cancelled: Cancelled. Your account stays on your devices only.
strings.bipe_mail_recovery_subject: Your link to get back into Bipe
strings.bipe_mail_recovery_body:
Someone asked to get back into your Bipe account with this email.

If it was you, open this link on the new phone, with Bipe installed:
%1$s

The link works for %2$s minutes. After the link, the app asks for your 8-digit PIN and there is a %3$s-hour wait. Your other devices get a notice and can cancel.

If it was not you, ignore this email and do not share the link with anyone.
strings.bipe_mail_verify_body:
Open this link to confirm that this email is yours:
%1$s

The link works for %2$s hours. Once you confirm it, this email lets you get back into your Bipe account if you lose your phone.

If you did not ask for this, ignore this email.
strings.bipe_mail_notice_subject: A change to your Bipe account
strings.bipe_mail_notice_recovery_started:
Someone asked to move your Bipe account to another device. If nobody cancels, this happens on %1$s.

If it was not you, open Bipe on one of your devices and cancel.
strings.bipe_mail_notice_pin_reset_started:
Someone asked for a new PIN for your Bipe account. If nobody cancels, the new PIN takes effect on %1$s.

If it was not you, open Bipe on one of your devices and cancel.
strings.bipe_mail_notice_new_device:
Your Bipe account signed in on a new device with the iCloud or Google backup and your PIN.

If it was not you, open Bipe on one of your devices, change your PIN and sign out of the devices you do not know.
strings.bipe_mail_notice_pin_changed:
The 8-digit PIN of your Bipe account changed.

If it was not you, open Bipe on one of your devices and change the PIN.
strings.bipe_mail_notice_email_removed:
This email no longer gets you back into your Bipe account.

If it was not you, open Bipe on one of your devices and check the recovery email.
strings.bipe_mail_waitlist_body:
You joined the Bipe waitlist. It is your turn now.

Open this link on your phone to install Bipe and make your account:
%1$s

The invite works for %2$s days and for one account. When you use the invite, or when it expires, Bipe deletes your email from the list.

If you did not ask to join the list, ignore this email.
strings.bipe_mail_footer: This email is from Bipe. Do not reply, because nobody reads this mailbox. Bipe never asks for your PIN by email.
strings.bipe_trust_identity_body: The seal shows the verified name. It doesn't guarantee that the person is honest.
strings.bipe_trust_contact_body: You confirmed who this person is. The seal checks their name through another source.
strings.bipe_trust_change_confirm_action: Confirm with the person through another channel before sending money.
strings.bipe_trust_lifecycle_unknown: We couldn't check this account's changes yet.
strings.bipe_trust_warning_absence_body: Even without a warning, confirm a money request with the person through another channel.
strings.bipe_pix_check_nothing_found: No Pix code or key found here.
strings.bipe_pix_check_code_dynamic: Charge code. The recipient's bank confirms the amount and the name when you pay.
strings.bipe_pix_check_code_bad_crc: This code was changed or is incomplete. Do not pay with it.
strings.bipe_pix_check_code_malformed: This Pix code is incomplete. Do not pay with it.
strings.bipe_pix_check_name_hint: Whoever made the code wrote this name. Only the name your bank shows counts.
strings.bipe_pix_check_bank_name: Your bank will show the recipient's name. Check it before you confirm.
strings.bipe_pix_check_private: The check runs only on your phone.
